title: Introducing Library in Vesence
summary: Your skills, integrations, agents and apps now live in one place. Keep them for yourself, or share them with your whole organization.
body_markdown:
## What It Is


Your skills, integrations, agents and apps now live in one place. Open Library from the Dock to find everything your agent can use.


## How It Works


Connect the tools you already use as integrations, including any MCP server. Add skills that teach Vesence how your team works. Create agents that take on tasks for you, and build apps around your workflows.


Keep them for yourself, or share them with your whole organization. Anything your organization shares can be added in a click, and your agent puts it to work.


## Getting Started


Library is available today in Vesence.[Book a demo](https://www.vesence.com/demo) or[request an invite](https://www.vesence.com/request-invite) .
